characters.description: An outworlder using shadow-based magic for disaster relief and monster suppression. His visible interventions attract public attention and strain his relationship with the Network.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: Jason's remote contact, whom he asks to notify the Network about the Hanoi branch attack and to secure local recordings.
characters.name: Farrah

characters.description: Jason's shadow familiar.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason's energy-beam familiar, used for rescue work as well as direct combat against monsters.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Jason's physical leech familiar, assisting him in close combat and recovery.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: A Sydney Network leader trying to contain public exposure of magic while preserving cooperation with Jason.
characters.name: Annabeth Tilden

characters.description: A man who receives footage of Jason's confrontation with the Hanoi branch and seeks a meeting with Mrs. West.
characters.name: Adrien Barbou

characters.description: An aid worker at a West African outbreak camp. Jason heals her cancer after she puts other patients first, then invites her to seek him out for instruction in healing magic.
characters.name: Dr. Chloe Baudrillard

characters.description: One of the EOA Cardinals directing the coordinated effort to collapse the Network's global detection grid.
characters.name: Mr. North

characters.description: Jason's sister, who reunites with him in Marrakesh after advancing to mid-iron rank through magic cores.
characters.name: Erika Asano

characters.description: Erika's daughter and Jason's niece, who is receiving ritual-magic lessons from Farrah.
characters.name: Emi

characters.description: Erika's husband, who has advanced to mid-iron rank through magic cores and joins the family reunion with Jason in Marrakesh.
characters.name: Ian

characters.description: Sydney's tactical operations director, coordinating defenses as silver-rank monsters place growing pressure on the Network.
characters.name: Koen Waters

characters.description: Jason's brother and a helicopter contractor working for the Network.
characters.name: Kaito

characters.description: A Network trainee whose adaptable abilities suit support work while he gains experience in the field.
characters.name: Greg

characters.description: A trainee accompanying Kaito as part of the Network's expanded training program.
characters.name: Asya

characters.description: A former EOA Cardinal who survives her apparent death by transferring her soul into a concealed clone body. She considers taking her knowledge of the EOA to the Network.
characters.name: Audrey Blaine

characters.description: Kaito's wife and a Castleton organizer who helps coordinate civilian protection as monster manifestations approach.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: An independent journalist who traces the public mystery around Jason to Asano Village. Jason chooses him as a direct media contact and entrusts him with an explanation of the approaching magical crisis.
characters.name: Jeremy Weston

characters.description: A silver-rank Japanese Network swordmaster sent to assess Jason and the clan he is building. She offers her expertise on a provisional basis.
characters.name: Akari Asano

characters.description: Jason's paternal grandmother and a retired doctor. She advises him on the Japanese Asano family's offer, recognizing both the value of Akari's aid and the possibility of concealed obligations.
characters.name: Yumi

characters.description: A newly arrived visitor to Asano Village who asks Jason for a place to stay.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: A Cabal contact living at Asano Village whose presence gives Jason information about Cabal activity.
characters.name: Craig Vermillion

characters.description: The gold-rank leader of the intelligent dinosaur monsters inside a collapsing protospace.
characters.name: King

characters.description: Akari's father and patriarch of the Japanese Asano clan, who formally receives Jason's party at the clan compound.
characters.name: Shiro

characters.description: Akari's younger sister, who escorts Jason's party during its visit to the Japanese Asano clan.
characters.name: Mei

characters.description: Shiro's mother and the strongest senior figure in the Japanese Asano clan. She presses for the clan to seize the Tiwari door despite Shiro's objections.
characters.name: Noriko

characters.description: A newly bronze-rank Tiwari trainee who welcomes Jason as the expected user of his family's ancient door.
characters.name: Itsuki Tiwari

characters.description: The Tiwari patriarch and custodian of the ancient door his family has guarded for generations.
characters.name: Denji

characters.description: Itsuki's father, the youngest brother of Tiwari patriarch Denji.
characters.name: Koya Tiwari

characters.description: A US Network deputy director leading a secret effort to appropriate Jason's node-repair project for American control.
characters.name: Emerson Cleary

characters.description: A gold-rank US Network asset kept in magical stasis between overwhelming-force missions and revived under Cleary's supervision.
characters.name: Jack Gerling

characters.description: A Cabal vampire covertly providing Craig Vermillion with modified blood, intelligence, and access information from within vampire circles.
characters.name: Franklin

characters.description: A newly awakened gold-rank ancient vampire who rejects secrecy and prepares an open assault against Sydney's magical defenders and government.
characters.name: Lord Willoughby
